fx_grass_clippings.notes: puff of cut grass behind the mower; spawn every ~0.3s at the mower's left (rear) wheel

fx_toy_shredded.notes: a toy gets mowed: soft poof of confetti and bits; centre on the toy

fx_toy_fall_shadow.notes: shadow on the grass where a toy will land; spread the 4 frames over the 1s before landing, hold the last

fx_toy_land.notes: little bounce of dust; bottom row on the ground, centred on the toy
